question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Camouflage
solution: The correct answer is **"Disguise."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Camouflage"** means to disguise or blend in with the surroundings. (छद्मावरण धारण करना) • **Example**: *The tent was **camouflaged**__ to avoid detection by infiltrating enemy soldiers.* • **"Disguise"** is a synonym of **camouflage**. • It means to conceal or change the appearance of something. (आकृति, आवाज़ आदि को ऐसे बदल लेना या बदल देना कि पहचाना न जा सके) __ • **Example**: *They **disguised**__ themselves as fishermen and escaped in a boat.* • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Sabotage** means to deliberately destroy or obstruct something. (जान-बूझ कर तोड़-फोड़ करना) • **Execute** means to carry out a task or put a plan into action. (क़ानूनन मृत्‍युदंड देना) • **Gigantic** means extremely large in size or scale. (अत्‍यधिक बड़ा; विशाल, विराट) 3b:Tbf0, The correct answer is **"Obvious."**
